description.p: Ferramari turns local videos into animated desktop wallpapers on Linux. It provides per-monitor playback, a library, a community catalogue and power-aware playback controls.
The application uses mpv for video playback and an Iced control window for managing wallpapers. X11 is supported directly; Wayland sessions currently use XWayland for wallpaper surfaces.
The control surface redrawn to the reference design, and the shutdown path made real.

ul.li: New shell: gradient backdrop, app-drawn title bar, navigation rail, and five pages built from one shared material.
The Home hero shows the playing wallpaper's own frame, with transport, mute and volume over it.
The Library is a grid of cards with measured resolution and frame rate, a type filter and search.
The frame-rate tile reports the rate the decoder produces, capped by the display's measured refresh rate, not the rate the file was authored at.
Install now copies a downloaded wallpaper into the library folder instead of playing it from the pruned cache.
Run in background registers or withdraws the tray icon at once.
SIGTERM stops the server cleanly again; it used to kill it mid-fade and orphan the players.
Russian and Japanese catalogs are complete; they were never installed before.

description.p: Major architecture update: GTK-free Iced control surface and native Linux wallpaper surfaces.

ul.li: Replaced the GTK control window with a separate Iced application communicating with the server over D-Bus.
Removed GTK, GDK and WebKitGTK from the workspace dependencies.
Moved wallpaper surface creation to the media layer using X11.
Kept the existing library, catalogue, playback and power-management services in the server.
Web-page wallpapers are temporarily unavailable while a replacement browser engine is evaluated.

description.p: Fullscreen windows now pause the wallpaper, on Wayland sessions too.

ul.li: The occlusion watcher runs on XWayland, so X11 games and players pause playback.
Pausing stops decoding instead of leaving the player running silently.
The pause and mute switches are visible on Wayland sessions.
A crashed web-process page is detected and reloaded instead of leaving a blank desktop.

description.p: Streaming no longer re-runs yt-dlp on every reload.

ul.li: A resolved stream is cached per page URL and screen height for 15 minutes.

description.p: Fixed a layout regression that clipped content at the right edge.
Initial public release with the GTK control surface.
